rule: SLC: no propulsor tilts (articulation is Fixed or Other only)
TW, SLC, SRW, TF, PTC, RC: articulation Fixed on every propulsor set (TP, CVT, MR free; DS has L7)
MR and RC: zero wings, no wing configuration recorded
CVT: at least two of tilting rotor, fixed rotor, tilting wing; suspended by articulation Other or a quick override
TW: every wing that carries propulsors is Tiltable; a thrust source that does not tilt with a wing makes it CVT; control-only propulsors are not thrust; suspended by Other
applies_at: M2 and M3 (after all wings declared)

rule: TF: fuselage kinematics is Tail-sitter or Variable Incidence (perturb.py tests TiltBody, Variable Incidence, LevelCabin)
TP: only tilting rotors; every wing Fixed and every rotor tilts on its own mount or a tilting boom; control-only exempt; suspended by Other or an override
RC and PTC: fuselage kinematics Whole-Body Pitch (BodyPitch)

A propulsor on a tilting wing, boom on a tilting wing, tilting boom set or tilting empennage has articulation Fixed (tested group by group when boom groups and boom propulsor types are equal in number); a boom tick 'on the fixed part of the wing' does not tilt
SLC and SRW: thrust kinematics Horizontal or Vertical, never Mixed
Code not TW, TP, DS, CVT or SRW and record moves nothing: every approved figure's aircraft state is Invariant
perturb_py_line_where_broken_lock_is_fla: not tested in perturb.py (T1/T2 fields are not perturbed; perturb.py:24-26)
